import http.server, functools
class SemCache(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = 'HTTP/1.1'
    def end_headers(self):
        self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
        super().end_headers()
SemCache.extensions_map['.mjs'] = 'text/javascript'
http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 4184), functools.partial(SemCache, directory='Portal')).serve_forever()
